name: Portarra Lodge

tagline.en: A lodge on the shores of Lough Corrib, built for anglers: five large en-suite rooms, a full Irish breakfast and the lake on your doorstep.
tagline.ga: Lóistín ar chladach Loch Coirib, tógtha d’iascairí: cúig sheomra mhóra en-suite, bricfeasta Éireannach agus an loch ag do dhoras.

mapQuery: Portarra Lodge, Tullykyne, Moycullen, Co. Galway

en: Portarra Lodge stands on the shores of Lough Corrib near Moycullen. It was built as guest accommodation and set up as an angling centre.
There are five large, comfortable bedrooms, all en-suite, and a full Irish breakfast before you head out on the water for brown trout, salmon or pike.
ga: Tá Portarra Lodge ar chladach Loch Coirib in aice le Maigh Cuilinn. Tógadh é mar lóistín d’aíonna agus cuireadh in oiriúint é mar ionad iascaireachta.
Tá cúig sheomra leapa mhóra chompordacha ann, iad ar fad en-suite, agus bricfeasta Éireannach sula dtéann tú amach ar an uisce i ndiaidh breac donn, bradán nó liús.
